correctness.rationale: For a \(\mathcal J\)-eventually-different \(k\)-family, the simultaneous pairwise-distinct set is in \(\mathcal J^*\). FSP supplies an ultrafilter witness by Lemma 4.23. If that ultrafilter did not contain \(C_k=\{n:F(n)=k\}\), one can diagonalize pointwise against all \(k\) members on an ultrafilter-large set where \(F(n)>k\), contradicting maximality. Conversely, an ultrafilter containing a positive \(C_k\) sees the \(k\) functions exhaust all coordinate values on a large pairwise-distinct set, so finite-union primeness yields \(\mathcal U^*\)-maximality. The separate existence condition for a \(k\)-member eventually-different family is \(\{n:F(n)\ge k\}\in\mathcal J^*\).
